narrative.headline: 2018 Honda Civic: steering leads the owner complaints
narrative.summary: Owners filed 603 complaints with NHTSA. Steering is by far the most reported area at 37% and is tied to 8 crashes, more than any other category. Fuel-related complaints come next, split across Fuel System and Gasoline (89 reports, 15% each) and Fuel/Propulsion System (71 reports, 12%). No deaths are reported, and the only fire shows up under the electrical system.
